title: Parseval identity for vector Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\\mathbb F_2$. Suppose $|f(x)|=1$ for every input $x$. Then the sum, over all vectors $\\gamma$ in that space, of the squares of the Fourier coefficients indexed by the support of $\\gamma$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\\mathbb F_2$
